dataset_type: GBIF country biodiversity spatial index + UNESCO MAB points

source.name: Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF)
source.attribution_note: GBIF occurrence records have varying licences and attribution requirements. Check each original record before reuse.

summary.interpretation: Cumulative, deduplicated GBIF occurrence points appended in rotating daily batches. The current published record set is incomplete relative to GBIF's full catalogue; it is not a census or a confirmed species range.
